'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2024 Democratic Republic of the Congo coup attempt]]
**The [[Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo]] say that they foiled a coup by armed men in [[Kinshasa]] that killed two police officers and four attackers, including the coup's leader, [[Christian Malanga]], a opposition leader of the [[United Congolese Party]]. Around 50 attackers, including Malanga's 20-year-old son and a [[US]] citizen from [[Maryland]], are arrested. [https://apnews.com/article/congo-coup-attempt-death-toll-malanga-tshisekedi-968b2726546f90a8bfbd5d222d513708 (AP)]
*[[2024 New Caledonia unrest]]
**[[France]] deploys law enforcement to [[New Caledonia]] to regain control of the road to [[La Tontouta International Airport]], which is currently controlled by protesters. [https://www.reuters.com/world/france-mobilises-police-regain-control-new-caledonia-airport-road-2024-05-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**At least six people are killed and 27 others are injured in a [[Russia]]n [[Double tap#Double-tap strike|double tap]] [[missile]] strike on a recreation area near [[Kharkiv]]. Separately, five people are killed and nine others are injured in a Russian strike using a [[multiple launch rocket system]] on two villages in [[Kupiansk Raion]], [[Kharkiv Oblast]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-air-attack-kharkiv-kills-least-four-says-local-official-2024-05-19/ (Reuters)] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Varzaqan helicopter crash]]
**A [[Bell 212]] helicopter crashes in [[Varzaqan]], [[East Azerbaijan province]], [[Iran]], killing all the eight people on board, including [[President of Iran|President]] [[Ebrahim Raisi]] and [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Foreign Minister]] [[Hossein Amir-Abdollahian]]. [https://apnews.com/article/helicopter-iran-raisi-crash-azerbaijan-3ef9fe5772fb06f6d9dcc371b115923f (AP)]
*Two people are killed and five others are missing after a boat collision on the [[Danube]] river near [[Verőce, Hungary|Verőce]], [[Hungary]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/two-dead-five-missing-after-suspected-boat-collision-danube-2024-05-19/ (Reuters)]
*Seven villages on the island of [[Halmahera]], [[Indonesia]], are forced to evacuate after the [[Mount Ibu]] volcano erupts. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/eruption-indonesias-mt-ibu-forces-seven-villages-evacuate-2024-05-19/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Argentina–Spain relations]]
**[[Spain]] recalls its ambassador to [[Argentina]] after [[President of Argentina]] [[Javier Milei]] calls Spanish [[Prime Minister of Spain|Prime Minister]] [[Pedro Sánchez]]'s wife [[Begoña Gómez]] corrupt during a rally in [[Madrid]] and also refuses to meet with [[Felipe VI|King Felipe VI]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/spain-recalls-ambassador-after-argentinas-milei-calls-pms-wife-corrupt-2024-05-19/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Dominican Republic general election]]
**President [[Luis Abinader]] wins re-election with 59% of the popular vote. [https://www.bbc.com/mundo/articles/c899gzw3pero (BBC Mundo)]

'''Science and technology'''
* A bright [[meteor]] crossed the skies of the [[Iberian Peninsula]], producing a bluish flash of light that was widely recorded by security cameras and observers. [https://www.bbc.com/news/av/world-europe-69034415 (BBC)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023–24 Premier League]]
**[[Manchester City F.C.|Manchester City]] win the [[Premier League]], becoming the first team in the 136-year history of the [[Football League]] to win four consecutive top-flight titles.
